quote.text: No man can have a peaceful life who thinks too much about lengthening it
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Embrace the present moments with your children instead of obsessing over their future or your own longevity; true joy is found in the now.
    • By focusing on quality time and nurturing relationships today, you invest in a fulfilling family life that resonates far beyond the quest for a prolonged existence.
  • Leadership
    • A leader should avoid overthinking the long term at the expense of current opportunities; wisdom lies in making sound decisions in the present.
    • When the quest for extended influence overshadows immediate actions, it may lead to stagnation—focus on actionable insights to inspire and guide effectively.
  • Product Management
    • Obsessing over the distant future of a product can hinder the responsiveness and agility required for today’s rapidly changing market.
    • Focus on pragmatic, iterative improvements that address current user needs, ensuring that your product evolves naturally without over-planning its longevity.
